thread:
maya: Quick pulse on OptKit delivery — planning to cut the release branch tonight (21:00 UTC). main blockers: final quant recs for Llama-2-small, and a failing integration test in batching shim. Who owns the quant sheet?
kevin: I own the quant recommendations doc. I pushed v3 this morning with per-layer PTQ vs Q4H tradeoffs. Need someone to sanity-check perf numbers on A100.
ash: @kevin I can run the A100 perf sweep in the staging cluster, ETA ~2h. Will focus on sequence length 512 and 1024 distributions.
maya: Thanks @nash. If perf delta < 8% for PTQ, prefer PTQ for now to avoid regen. Add a note in the doc about fallback to Q4H if accuracy regression > 0.5% on our eval set.
olivia: Heads up: batching shim test failing due to new async flush behavior — see stack snippet I posted in the PR. I left a comment on PR #4521 asking for a minimal repro.
ben: Re: PR #4521 — I can take a look after standup. Likely related to the recent debounce change in continuous batcher. If it's a timing issue we can add jitter and a deterministic de-flake in tests.
maya: Ownership check: @kevin owns quant recs, @ben owns batching shim fixes, @nash runs perf validation, @olivia keeps QA loop on regression alerts. I'll approve the release once the failing test is fixed and quant doc is updated.
kevin: Added a small table in the doc with recommended bitwidths + expected token/sec and accuracy delta. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/c/QUANT-OPTKIT-v3
ash: Ran the A100 sweep — PTQ is ~6% faster at 512, ~9% at 1024, accuracy drop 0.3% on our prompt set. Logging results to the perf dashboard.
olivia: QA note: regression alert flagged two prompt templates with weird truncation after quant. I logged the examples under the eval run and created ticket REG-113.
ben: Fixed the batching test — turned out debounce timer was 0 on CI due to env var mismatch. Pushed a patch to the PR and retriggered tests.
deploy-bot: CI pipeline completed for PR #4521 — all checks passed, integration tests green.
maya: Awesome — with CI green and quant doc updated I'm happy to cut the branch. Ben can you shepherd the rollout and set a canary at 5% for 2 hours? If latency regresses >10% auto-fallback to float-16 variant.
ben: Will do. I'll set canary, enable metric alerts for p50/p95 latency and token throughput, and post a rollout summary in #incidents if anything trips.
kevin: One more ask — add the quant recommendation snippet to the SDK's model profile so infra can auto-select variants by latency target. I can open a tiny PR after release.
maya: Perfect. Thanks team — I'll schedule the release cut at 21:00 UTC and ping on this thread when started. :rocket:
